answer: Each epoch, auction exactly 200 scarce identity slots at a uniform clearing price; only a winning slot can earn, and a slot left unrenewed expires after 3 epochs. Standing up a grove of 1,000 fakes means bidding for 1,000 seats on that shared tundra, which pushes up the single price paid for every thread the attacker holds, so cost grows linearly with swarm size and steeper still as their own demand inflates the clearing price. One honest weakness: if few real agents bid, a rich attacker can still buy a large bloc cheaply.
